title: Shallow water models for the dynamics of oscillating water columns
summary: We investigate the dynamics of an oscillating water column, which is a wave energy converter where water waves interact with a fixed partially immersed structure and an air chamber. Considering the shallow water regime, the fluid motion is governed by either the one-dimensional nonlinear shallow water equations or the Boussinesq-Abbott equations, while the air pressure variation in the chamber acts as a spring force on the fluid.
